text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Ah, good day. What a coincidence to be meeting out here. ...Hm, what's this?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おー
お疲れ。
奇遇だね
こんなところで。
……ん、
なにこれ？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Ah, sorry. I don't recall ever getting a birthday present from a man, so my brain just couldn't process it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
ごめん。
男の人から誕プレ貰ったのなんて記憶になさ過ぎて、
脳が処理しきれんかったわ。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Actually, there's no need for you to be so considerate. Give presents to your classmates or something. Oh, you're giving birthday gifts to them too? ...I see. Well, that makes sense.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ってか、
そんな気遣わなくていいのに。
もっと同級生とかにあげなよ。
あ、
それもあげてる？
……そっか。
ま、
そりゃそうだよね。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe, sorry. I haven't even thanked you yet. Thank you. That said... my age remains a trade secret between us, okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ふふ、
ごめん。
お礼がまだだったね。
ありがとう。
って、
いくつになったかは企業秘密ね？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? ...O-Of course I do. There's no way a grown woman like me wouldn't have plans on her birthday. What a foolish question... I just so happen to have some free time this year, though.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……え？　
……そ、
そりゃあるに決まってんじゃん。
誕生日の夜に大人の女が予定ないわけないじゃん。
それは愚問だよ……
今年は
たまたま暇だけど。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Hmm... What's this... Wait, hold on. This is an invitation to a restaurant that's hard to get a reservation for... And you want to go together... No, just how much of a playboy are you...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん……
なに
これ……
って、
ちょっと待った。
これ
予約の取れないレストランの招待券じゃん……
一緒に行こう
って……
いや
ちょっとプレイボーイ過ぎないか……

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe, all right. I'll join you since you went to the trouble of preparing it. ...But can I go home and get ready first?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ふふ、
分かったよ。
せっかく用意してくれたんだから付き合うよ。
……でも
一回家帰って用意していいかな？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: I'll go and prepare some food for Iroha. Hehe, I'm not dressing up or anything so don't get your hopes up♪ You're wondering why? Don't worry. Just some self-loathing.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いろはにご飯用意してくるからさ。
ふふ、
おめかしとかじゃないから期待すんなよ♪
って、
しないか。
自己嫌悪だわ
今の
忘れて。

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Catch you later, then. I'm looking forward to it. Hehe.
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃ、
またあとで。
楽しみにしてるわ。
ふふ。
